name: Billionaire's Canvas Cinderella
overview: Impoverished artist Ella, sold to gangster Derek by her mother, was rescued by billionaire Victor. A drugged encounter left her pregnant, triggering his abrupt marriage. Unbeknownst to him, childhood love Selena retaliated with schemes exposing Ella's true heritage. Ultimately, they overcame threats and lies to build a life together, defying all odds.
